result:
I would change the world so that every person could feel, in the moment, when their beliefs are being shaped by fear, pride, or habit—rather than by evidence. Not as a way to force anyone to think differently, but as an unmistakable internal signal: “You are not being honest with yourself right now.”

So much of the world’s suffering comes from people who are absolutely certain they’re right, and who have no internal mechanism for noticing when that certainty is a defense mechanism. If we could each see our own self-deception in real time, we’d still disagree—but we’d disagree with more humility, more curiosity, and far less cruelty.
